title: The bell rang upstairs. The top deck was empty.
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, rainy British city at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: Someone kept ringing the bell upstairs. The top deck was empty.

scenes.narration: Someone kept ringing the bell upstairs. The top deck was empty.

shots.prompt: empty upper deck of a red double-decker night bus, rows of empty seats, flickering fluorescent lights, rain on windows

scenes.narration: I always take the last night bus home from work. Half one in the morning. Rain on the windows.

shots.prompt: lower deck of a night bus, rain streaked windows, blurred orange street lights outside, empty seats

scenes.narration: I sat downstairs, near the driver. Nobody else got on. Then the bell rang.

shots.prompt: back of a bus driver in a dim cab seen from passenger seat, wet windscreen, wipers, night road

scenes.narration: Nobody came down the stairs. The driver didn't stop. He didn't even look up.

shots.prompt: narrow curved staircase of a double-decker bus leading up into darkness, dim light at the top

scenes.narration: Two stops later, it rang again. Twice this time. I asked if someone was up there.

shots.prompt: red STOP bell button glowing on a yellow bus pole, close up, dark bus interior

scenes.narration: He said, don't go upstairs, love. Not on this route.

shots.prompt: bus rearview mirror reflecting the driver's eyes in shadow, face not visible, cold blue light

scenes.narration: Then my mobile buzzed. A text from my mum. Why are you whispering? I can hear you on the phone.

shots.prompt: hand holding a glowing phone in a dark bus seat, rain reflections, phone screen light on fingers, no face

overlays.text: Why are you whispering? I can hear you on the phone.

scenes.narration: I hadn't rung her. I hadn't said a word all night. Another text. Who's that with you? They keep saying your name.

shots.prompt: phone screen glow in a dark bus, passenger seat empty beside it, fog on window

overlays.text: Who's that with you? They keep saying your name.

scenes.narration: The bell rang again. Long, this time. Then footsteps. Slow. Coming down the stairs.

shots.prompt: bottom of a bus staircase, a dark shadow of legs on the steps coming down, no face, flickering light

scenes.narration: The driver finally looked at me in the mirror. That's your stop, he said. I wasn't anywhere near home.

shots.prompt: bus doors opening onto an empty foggy country road at night, no houses, single street lamp

scenes.narration: Would you get off, or stay on?
